decision.rationale: I'm declining this dispute. The charge TXN-007986 is for 6.48 EUR at Lumen Media on card CRD-000237. It was made on 2026-08-25 and posted on 2026-08-26. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 59 days after posting, so it is within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). The only written cancellation is DOC-000039, a confirmation issued by the merchant. It says the cancellation took effect on 2026-08-27, two days after the charge. That means the charge came first and covers a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled, so the policy calls for a decline (recurring-cancelled-after-charge).

proposed_actions.reason: The Lumen Media charge of 6.48 EUR was made on 2026-08-25. The merchant's cancellation confirmation shows your subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-08-27, after that date. The charge therefore covers a period before your cancellation took effect.
